description: This file defines the class 'ComponentLocationResolver' which implements the 'LocationResolver' interface. It provides methods to resolve component-based locations into URLs, handling component-specific path logic and URI conversion.

classes.name: ComponentLocationResolver
classes.description: A class that resolves component-specific location strings into URLs, facilitating locating resources within components.

methods.name: resolveLocation
methods.description: Converts a component location string into a URL, handling path adjustments and URI conversion.

methods.name: getBaseLocation
methods.description: Static utility method that processes a location string to extract and build a base location path considering component configurations.
